about_the_game:
Execute Your Strategies

Play strategy cards to expand your cult and turn it into a powerful organization. Every choice matters—some moves will bring in new followers, while others might attract unwanted attention from the authorities.

Unlock New Cards

Grow your deck by acquiring more powerful strategies. From subtle manipulation to outright madness, each new card unlocks fresh opportunities to reshape your cult's destiny.

Manage the Risk

Your actions won’t go unnoticed. Keep an eye on police interest, balance your decisions wisely, and don’t let an untimely investigation bring your grand plan crashing down.

Gather Followers

A cult is nothing without its believers. Recruit new members, maintain their devotion, and decide whether they are mere pawns in your game or the foundation of something greater.

Build Your Power

Will you become a revered prophet leading your followers to enlightenment, or a ruthless mastermind controlling their every move? Your decisions will shape the fate of your cult—and how history remembers you.
